scripts.build: npm run -s generate && npm run -s bundle
scripts.build:production: npm run -s generate && npm run -s bundle:production
scripts.bundle: npm run rebuild && node ./scripts/patch-generated-modules.mjs && webpack --config ./webpack.config.js --mode development
scripts.bundle:production: npm run rebuild && node ./scripts/patch-generated-modules.mjs && webpack --config ./webpack.config.js --mode production
scripts.start: npm run -s generate && THEIA_DEFAULT_PLUGINS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins THEIA_ANDROID_LITE=0 THEIA_PLUGINS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins THEIA_EXTENSIONS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins theia start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100 --plugins=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins --ovsx-router-config=./configs/ovsx-router-config.json
scripts.start:android: npm run -s generate && THEIA_DEFAULT_PLUGINS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins THEIA_ANDROID_LITE=1 THEIA_ANDROID_LITE_HOME=${THEIA_ANDROID_LITE_HOME:-./android-data} THEIA_PLUGINS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins THEIA_EXTENSIONS=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins theia start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100 --plugins=local-dir:../../plugins,local-dir:./plugins --ovsx-router-config=./configs/ovsx-router-config.json
